description: Built as the residence of Trinidad and Tobago's Anglican bishops, this simple and elegant French Colonial style building features intricate stonework, a wraparound veranda and contemporary Scottish cast-iron architectural elements. It forms part of the Magnificent Seven mansions situated in Port of Spain around the Queen's Park Savannah. Listed opening hours: Monday - Friday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
